# unifi_protect_light (Resource)

A UniFi Protect floodlight (UP-FloodLight), identified by MAC. Configures the existing, adopted device over the private Protect API (`/proxy/protect/api/lights/<id>`): name, paired camera, activation mode/schedule, LED brightness, PIR (motion) duration/sensitivity, and ambient-light (lux) sensitivity. `terraform destroy` removes the light from state and leaves it configured; set `forget_on_destroy = true` to unadopt it. **Config writes are HIL-unverified — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mac` (String) Floodlight MAC address (the natural key); any separator/case is accepted and normalized to lowercase colon-separated form. The device must be adopted and visible to Protect. Immutable — changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `camera` (String) Object id of the camera paired to this light (motion from that camera can trigger it).
- `enable_at` (String) When the light is allowed to activate: `dark`, `night`, or `fulltime`.
- `force_led_on` (Boolean) Force the main LED on regardless of mode.
- `forget_on_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, `terraform destroy` unadopts (forgets) the light instead of just removing it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `indicator_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the status indicator LED is enabled.
- `led_level` (Number) LED brightness level (model-dependent scale, typically 1–6).
- `lux_sensitivity` (String) Ambient-light (lux) sensitivity threshold: `low`, `medium`, or `high`.
- `mode` (String) Activation mode: `off`, `motion`, `always`, or `schedule`.
- `name` (String) Light display name.
- `pir_duration` (Number) How long the light stays on after motion, in milliseconds.
- `pir_sensitivity` (Number) PIR motion sensitivity (0–100).

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Current management IP/host.
- `id` (String) Protect object id (24-hex). Import key.
- `is_adopted` (Boolean) Whether the light is adopted by this console.
- `is_light_on` (Boolean) Whether the main LED is currently on.
- `model` (String) Hardware model (e.g. `UP FloodLight`).
- `state` (String) Connection state (`CONNECTED`, `DISCONNECTED`, …).
- `type` (String) Device type identifier.
